messages.content: I can answer questions, search the web, open sites or apps, play music or videos, generate text or images, write code, essays or emails, and help you plan ideas—all from your Windows laptop, Sir. Just tell me what you need.
which one to do first web development by python or AI ?

I’d start with web development in Python, Sir, because it gives you immediate, visual results and solid programming fundamentals that will make learning AI later much smoother; the only downside is you’ll postpone the math and theory essential for AI.
I don’t have your phone number on record, Sir. Would you like to share it now?
